mapper.sql: id, agent_id, agent_name, agent_level, rank_type, rank_period, stat_date, performance_value, ranking, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_performance_ranking WHERE rank_type = #{rankType} AND rank_period = #{rankPeriod} AND stat_date = #{statDate} ORDER BY ranking ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_performance_ranking (agent_id, agent_name, agent_level, rank_type, rank_period, stat_date, performance_value, ranking) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{agentLevel}, #{rankType}, #{rankPeriod}, #{statDate}, #{performanceValue}, #{ranking})
mapper.update: DELETE FROM dms_performance_ranking WHERE rank_type = #{rankType} AND rank_period = #{rankPeriod} AND stat_date = #{statDate}
